messages.content: 关于论文《A computational linguistic study of personal recovery in bipolar disorder》，How are the individuals with bipolar disorder identified?

claims.text: Twitter and Reddit users with a BD diagnosis will be identified automatically via self-reported diagnosis statements, such as 'I was diagnosed with BD-I last week'.
To do so, the authors will extend on the diagnosis patterns and terms for BD provided by prior work (BIBREF47).
Relevant blogs will be manually identified, and their authors will be contacted to obtain informed consent for using their texts.

Data relevant for BD in general as well as for personal recovery in BD is planned to be collected from three sources: Twitter, Reddit (focusing on mental health-related content unlike previous work), and blogs authored by affected individuals.
Implicit consent is assumed from users on Twitter and Reddit to use their public tweets and posts.

claims.text: 数据计划从三个来源收集：Twitter、Reddit（不同于以往工作，聚焦心理健康相关内容）以及由受影响个体撰写的博客。
在Twitter和Reddit上，患有双相障碍（BD）诊断的用户将通过自我报告的诊断陈述自动识别，例如“I was diagnosed with BD-I last week”。
为实现自动识别，作者将扩展前人提供的双相障碍诊断模式和术语。
对于这些平台上的用户，假定其默示同意使用其公开推文和帖子。
相关博客将被人工识别，并联系其作者以获得使用其文本的知情同意。
以往的双相障碍数据集存在限制：Twitter数据集无法用于进一步研究，而两个Reddit数据集中的心理健康相关内容被有意移除。
